status: Declared before fitting or inspecting piecewise-affine validation outcomes
role: Alternative emulator sensitivity; cubic Bernstein is the separate primary model chosen by the research team
observations: Original HTE measured responses only; negative measurements retained
aggregation: Group exact duplicate compositions; arithmetic mean within each group; retain all source observations separately
input_geometry: Four mass fractions on the simplex; three orthonormal coordinates for Euclidean Delaunay triangulation
input_grid: Verify the source 0.02 mass-fraction grid to floating-point tolerance and retain integer grid coordinates for exact zero-volume tests
model: Continuous piecewise affine barycentric interpolant; no response clipping, smoothing, jitter, tuning, or extrapolation
holdout_integrity: All repeated observations of a composition stay within one group. Fit each fold only on its training groups. Exclude and count held-out points outside the training convex hull. Never move held-out hull vertices into training.
final_emulator: Refit on all HTE composition means after validation for simulation use; validation scores refer only to held-out predictions
bounds: Report maximum L2 norm of affine tangent gradients and maximum (max(g4)-min(g4))/2 for L1 distance; these bound the emulator only, not an unknown physical material response
failure_policy: Report degeneracy, hull gaps, large bounds, or poor prediction; do not tune the model to improve downstream policy outcomes
